📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie.
  • Dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux.
  • Dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie. Un sursaut salutaire provoqué par Zinédine Zidane, qui n'a pas hésité à hausser le ton dans le vestiaire.

Dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Trois jours après le revers concédé face à l'Italie à San Siro, premier accroc de l'ère Zinédine Zidane, les Tricolores se devaient de réagir. Toutefois, à la pause, le score restait nul et vierge (0-0), actant un dixième match de suite sans marquer lors du premier acte. Un manque d'efficacité chronique qui a fini par agacer le sélectionneur.

Dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive. Le sélectionneur souhaitait corriger l'apathie collective et le manque d'agressivité à la perte du ballon constatés durant le premier acte. Une mise au point nécessaire pour relancer son équipe. Au micro de TF1 après la rencontre, le défenseur de Liverpool Jérémy Jacquet a ainsi dévoilé la teneur du discours : « Le coach nous a dit à la mi-temps qu’il trouvait qu’on n’était pas assez agressifs à la perte du ballon. On l’a bien rectifié en deuxième. […] Pour être honnête, il n’a pas gueulé, mais a haussé le ton sur nos axes de progression à la perte de balle. Pour lui, on pouvait faire mieux. Il trouvait qu’on gardait trop le ballon et voulait que l’on bouge plus. ».

It has been revealed that de son côté, le technicien tricolore a confirmé avoir bousculé ses troupes tout en restant mesuré, préférant insister sur les ajustements tactiques exigés sur la pelouse. « Ce n'est pas la défense. C'est tous ensemble. On doit aller presser tous ensemble et quand on ne presse pas, on se resserre tous ensemble. C'est des choses qu'on doit mettre en place. On a besoin de garder le ballon. On aime courir avec ballon, sans ballon, ce n'est pas notre truc. On l'a mieux en seconde période en jouant en deux touches. On doit le répéter. Les murs n’ont pas tremblé à la mi-temps. On a rectifié des choses et c’était mieux en seconde. La réaction était très bonne », a détaillé Zinédine Zidane sur TF1.

En effet, la copie rendue au cours des quarante-cinq premières minutes a déçu le patron des Bleus. Malgré une possession de balle établie à 60 %, la France n'a jamais su emballer la rencontre, gaspillant de l'énergie à courir après le cuir tout en concédant de larges décalages. Le pressing tricolore s'est révélé particulièrement inefficace. Sur le plateau de TF1, Zinédine Zidane a ainsi exprimé sa frustration : « C'était l'objectif de se qualifier, en étant éventuellement premier. Par contre, sur le contenu, on peut être un peu perplexe, surtout dans notre pression en première mi-temps. Quand on ne voit pas certaines choses sur le terrain, on est un peu frustrés. C'est surtout dans la pression, parce qu'on laissait faire les décalages et on n'a pas été bons du tout dans notre pression. On a rectifié ça à la mi-temps et on a été meilleurs après. Ce sont des choses où on doit encore s'améliorer. Moi, je n'étais pas content, les joueurs non plus. Mais on a rectifié. ».

It has been revealed that D'ailleurs, le sélectionneur a réitéré son agacement en conférence de presse d'après-match pour cibler ce dysfonctionnement inhabituel. Pour Zinédine Zidane, son équipe a été défaillante dans sa première ligne de récupération en concédant bien trop de liberté à l'adversaire : « Ce qui n’a pas été bon, c’est notre première pression. On l’a très bien fait sur les cinq autres matchs, même contre l’Italie. En revanche, ce soir, on a été défaillants, notamment en première mi-temps. On a laissé beaucoup trop d’espaces. On a rectifié le tir en deuxième mi-temps où on a été très bons dans l’utilisation du ballon. Même si on peut encore mieux faire, parce que j’ai des joueurs de qualité qui peuvent garder le ballon. Ce sont eux (les Turcs) qui doivent courir derrière le ballon », a insisté Zinédine Zidane.

In a recent development, au retour des vestiaires, le discours du sélectionneur a porté ses fruits. Nettement plus agressifs et tranchants en jouant en deux touches de balle, les Bleus ont rapidement trouvé la faille sur un but contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu (49e). Lancés, les Tricolores ont ensuite fait le break grâce à Éli Junior Kroupi (79e). La réduction du score tardive d'Abdülkerim Bardakcı (89e) n'a rien changé à l'issue de la rencontre (2-1). Une réaction salutaire.

Ainsi, ce succès combiné à la défaite de l'Italie contre la Belgique (1-4) permet à la France de terminer à la première place de sa poule. Les hommes de Zinédine Zidane valident officiellement leur qualification pour les quarts de finale du Final 8 de la Ligue des nations. Les Bleus connaîtront leur prochain adversaire lors du tirage au sort programmé le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 en Suisse, avant d'aborder cette double confrontation en mars 2027.

In a recent development, au sortir de la victoire obtenue face à la Turquie dimanche soir à Bordeaux, Zinédine Zidane n'a pas pu débriefer la rencontre avec ses troupes dans le vestiaire. En raison des départs précipités des joueurs, le sélectionneur de l'équipe de France a dû faire l'impasse sur son discours d'après-match.

Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, l'équipe de France a conclu sa phase de groupes de Ligue des nations par un succès contre la Turquie (2-1), devant 42 000 spectateurs au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Lors de cette 6e et dernière journée, les Bleus ont marqué un premier but grâce à une réalisation contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu à la 49e minute, puis un deuxième avec Éli Junior Kroupi à la 80e minute, avant la réduction du score turque par Abdülkerim Bardakcı à la 90e minute. Le coup de sifflet final a retenti à 22h38. Une fin de soirée agitée.

À 22h40, les Bleus ont effectué un timide tour d'honneur autour du rond central plutôt qu'autour du terrain, sans plusieurs cadres dont le capitaine Kylian Mbappé qui avait déjà quitté la pelouse. D'ailleurs, la distance entre les joueurs et les tribunes lors de ce tour d'honneur a provoqué quelques sifflets de supporters français déçus.

En effet, les départs se sont enchaînés à toute vitesse. Kylian Mbappé a quitté le stade Atlantique à 22h53, soit exactement quinze minutes après le coup de sifflet final, plusieurs témoins évoquant un joueur très pressé. Rayan Cherki et Malo Gusto ont ensuite quitté le stade ensemble valise à la main, suivis par Eduardo Camavinga. Une course contre la montre.

Industry observers note that et pour cause, la fermeture avancée de l'aéroport de Bordeaux-Mérignac imposait un timing très serré. Plusieurs avions privés étaient ainsi prévus au décollage : un jet pour Milan à 00h05 et un autre pour Madrid à 00h12. De son côté, l'avion de la Fédération Française de Football a quitté la Gironde à 1h15.

In a recent development, passés en zone d'interviews, Andy Diouf et Pablo Pagis ont tous les deux confirmé l'absence de discours de Zinédine Zidane dans le vestiaire. « On n’a pas fait de discours », a déclaré Andy Diouf devant les micros. De son côté, Pablo Pagis a détaillé la gestion du sélectionneur tricolore : « Il a laissé tout le monde tranquille ».

Zinédine Zidane n'a pas retenu ses joueurs pressés en raison de la fatigue et du calendrier très serré de ce rassemblement de novembre, qui comptait deux matches en 72 heures.

It has been revealed that au-delà de cette fin de soirée au pas de course dans les couloirs du stade bordelais, les Tricolores ont validé leur qualification. Le prochain rendez-vous des Bleus de Zidane est fixé du 25 au 30 mars 2027 pour les quarts de finale aller-retour de la Ligue des nations.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il centrocampista parla del buon avvio di stagione e del clima nel gruppo.

Recent findings suggest that fisayo Dele-Bashiru è stato intervistato ai microfoni di Lazio Style Channel al rientro dagli impegni con la Nazionale, in vista della sfida di sabato tra Lazio e Lecce. Nel confronto racconta l'energia portata da Gattuso, la concorrenza interna e la voglia di dare il massimo per la squadra.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sto bene. Sono felice di essere tornato a Roma. Naturalmente, essere convocato in Nazionale è sempre un momento speciale, soprattutto in occasione delle qualificazioni alla Coppa d'Africa. Le partite sono andate abbastanza bene. La prima è stata positiva, la seconda poteva andare meglio, ma sono felice di essere tornato a Roma. Nel fine settimana ci aspetta una partita importante e non vediamo l'ora di giocarla.

It has been revealed that penso che quest'anno abbiamo iniziato molto bene con Gattuso. Ha portato nuova energia nello spogliatoio e credo che questo si veda nei rapporti tra i compagni, nel nostro rapporto con l'allenatore e anche in quello con i tifosi. Se riusciremo a continuare su questa strada, sarà perfetto.

According to recent reports, tanto, in questo momento c'è molta concorrenza. Quando ho l'opportunità di entrare in campo per aiutare la squadra, cerco sempre di dare il massimo. Se dovessi giocare nel fine settimana, darò come sempre tutto me stesso. Credo che questo sia importante perché, per arrivare lontano in campionato, non bisogna poter contare soltanto sugli undici titolari: anche i giocatori in panchina devono dare il proprio contributo. È fondamentale.

According to recent reports, credo che la concorrenza sia sicuramente positiva e faccia bene. Tutte le migliori squadre del mondo hanno molta competizione interna e penso che questo permetta alla squadra di esprimere al meglio. In questo momento l'atmosfera è molto buona. Credo che nello spogliatoio ci siano molte più battute e momenti di leggerezza rispetto alla scorsa stagione, quando la situazione era differente. Quest'anno siamo molto più uniti e questo contribuisce sicuramente a creare un bel clima all'interno del gruppo.

It has been revealed that da quando sono alla Lazio ho avuto diversi allenatori. Credo che quest'anno un aspetto importante sia il grande coinvolgimento di Gattuso nel lavoro con il gruppo e con ogni singolo giocatore. Ha un ottimo rapporto con tutti i componenti della squadra e penso che questo sia fondamentale. Inoltre, sa perfettamente cosa significhi essere in campo ai massimi livelli, avendo avuto una grande carriera da calciatore. È un allenatore di altissimo livello, tutti i ragazzi gli vogliono bene e dobbiamo continuare a ottenere risultati per lui.

Recent findings suggest that A livello personale sono una persona piuttosto tranquilla. Non lascio che quello che succede all'esterno influenzi troppo il mio modo di essere. Penso di comportarmi in campo proprio come nella vita di tutti i giorni: sono abbastanza rilassato e calmo, anche se so essere aggressivo quando serve. Direi che queste sono le caratteristiche che mi descrivono meglio.

A livello personale, il mio obiettivo è giocare il maggior numero possibile di partite e aiutare la squadra il più possibile, magari con gol e assist. Se riuscirò a fare tutto questo, penso che sarà una stagione davvero molto positiva, non soltanto per me, ma anche per tutti i ragazzi. Adesso dobbiamo semplicemente continuare a lavorare partita dopo partita. Speriamo di riuscire a proseguire su questa buona strada.

« Romario parle beaucoup » : La mise au point cinglante d'Ancelotti avec le Brésil !

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (770 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle.
  • La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour.
  • Présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle. Le sélectionneur de la Seleção a sèchement répondu aux attaques de Romario, qui réclamait publiquement son départ immédiat.

La tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour. Alors que les Japonais menaient rapidement grâce à Takefusa Kubo et Keito Nakamura, le doublé de Vinícius Júnior (33e, 75e) avait pourtant permis aux Auriverdes d'égaliser. Toutefois, le but concédé à Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (91e) dans le temps additionnel a scellé la défaite brésilienne.

Présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção. Le technicien italien a répondu en espagnol à l'ancien international. Une mise au point limpide. « C'est la liberté d'expression et, dans un pays démocratique, tout le monde peut avoir une opinion. Romario a donné la sienne, et tout le monde a le droit de dire des mensonges, des vérités ou des bêtises. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que Romario parle beaucoup, et il est dans son droit », a ainsi rétorqué l'entraîneur face aux journalistes.

In a recent development, cette sortie directe démontre la volonté du sélectionneur de balayer la polémique alors que la pression médiatique s'accentue. Carlo Ancelotti n'a pas souhaité polémiquer davantage avec l'ancienne gloire du football brésilien, se contentant de souligner avec ironie l'omniprésence médiatique de son détracteur.

Deux jours plus tôt, Romario n'avait pas mâché ses mots à la suite de la défaite concédée face à l'équipe nippone. L'ancien buteur brésilien avait réclamé la destitution immédiate du sélectionneur sur ses réseaux sociaux, estimant qu'Ancelotti ne disposait pas des qualités requises pour diriger le pays. « Ça suffit ! Prends tes affaires et va-t'en ! », avait notamment écrit Romario, très remonté contre l'entraîneur italien.

It has been revealed that au-delà de cette interpellation, Romario a tout de même reconnu les accomplissements passés de Carlo Ancelotti, qualifié d'« un des grands entraîneurs » en club, tout en appelant à son retour sur le Vieux Continent : « Retourne dans les clubs, où tu t'es fait un nom, car la sélection brésilienne ne peut pas continuer à prendre ce risque ». L'ancien international a également interpellé le président de la Confédération brésilienne de football (CBF), Samir Xaud, affirmant qu'il fallait désormais « le courage de prendre une décision ». Cette attaque fait suite à une fin de match sous haute tension contre le Japon, au cours de laquelle Carlo Ancelotti et l'attaquant Raphinha avaient été expulsés pour avoir protesté contre une faute présumée au départ de la troisième réalisation adverse.

Lucide quant au niveau affiché par ses joueurs sur le terrain, Carlo Ancelotti n'a éludé aucune question sur les difficultés actuelles de la Seleção. Lors de son point presse, le coach italien a dressé une autocritique sans concession sur le rendement de son groupe. « Je dois faire plus et je vais le faire. J'aime être ici, j'aime être dans la sélection nationale et je dois m'améliorer. Je dois faire plus pour que la sélection redevienne compétitive. Il y a longtemps que nous ne sommes plus compétitifs », a déclaré le technicien italien.

Sources indicate that toutefois, le sélectionneur brésilien a insisté sur la nature amicale de cette rencontre et la nécessité de renouveler son effectif en vue des futures échéances. « C'est évident que c'est le moment des essais. Nous essayons de nouveaux joueurs, en commençant par Gabriel Bontempo, André, Jonathan Jesus... Ce sont des évaluations très positives, sans mentionner de noms. Nous espérons toujours bien jouer, mais il est incompatible d'essayer, de renouveler et d'avoir l'équipe prête. Nous continuons avec une grande confiance dans cette voie et nous nous testerons contre Singapour », a détaillé le sélectionneur brésilien.

Après ce premier revers en Asie, le Brésil doit désormais se remobiliser pour son second match amical de la trêve internationale, prévu le mardi 17 novembre 2026 au Stade national de Singapour face à Singapour. Une rencontre que Carlo Ancelotti devra observer loin de la pelouse : le technicien italien est suspendu de banc de touche suite à son expulsion contre le Japon et ne pourra pas diriger directement ses hommes au bord du terrain. L'équipe devra également composer sans son attaquant Raphinha, lui aussi sous le coup d'une suspension. Pour animer son secteur offensif face aux Singapouriens, Carlo Ancelotti a d'ores et déjà annoncé la titularisation du jeune avant-centre Endrick pour le match du mardi 17 novembre 2026.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • C'est une annonce majeure pour le football belge en ce lundi 16 novembre 2026.
  • Recent findings suggest that L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi.
  • En quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

C'est une annonce majeure pour le football belge en ce lundi 16 novembre 2026. Sur son compte Instagram, Romelu Lukaku a officialisé son départ définitif de la sélection des Diables Rouges après seize années passées au plus haut niveau international.

Recent findings suggest that L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi. Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, Romelu Lukaku est resté sur le banc des remplaçants sans entrer en jeu, après avoir manqué le match précédent face à la Turquie en raison d'une légère blessure à la hanche. Pour accompagner son message d'adieu sur le réseau social, le joueur a publié une galerie photo retraçant son parcours international depuis ses débuts en mars 2010 à l'âge de 16 ans. Plusieurs coéquipiers emblématiques de la génération dorée, dont Axel Witsel et Thibaut Courtois, ont d'ailleurs salué publiquement sa carrière sous sa publication. Une page se tourne pour les Diables Rouges.

En quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable. L'avant-centre se retire en effet en tant que meilleur buteur absolu de l'histoire de la sélection belge avec 94 buts inscrits en 135 sélections. Au niveau des apparitions, le joueur n'est devancé que par Jan Vertonghen (157 sélections) et Axel Witsel (140 sélections). Pilier de la sélection durant plus d'une décennie, il a disputé quatre phases finales de Coupe du monde (2014, 2018 avec une 3e place, 2022 et 2026) ainsi que trois Championnats d'Europe (2016, 2020 et 2024). Son dernier match officiel sous le maillot des Diables Rouges remonte ainsi au 5 octobre 2026 contre l'équipe de France en Ligue des nations, lors d'une défaite (1-4).

Cette annonce constitue d'ailleurs un revirement par rapport aux looks initialement affichés par l'intéressé. En effet, l'attaquant avait affirmé en janvier 2026 que la Coupe du monde 2026 ne marquerait pas sa dernière compétition majeure avec la Belgique. La sélection des Diables Rouges a elle aussi tenu à rendre hommage à son avant-centre sur son compte officiel X, saluant un joueur qui a écrit un incroyable chapitre de l'histoire de l'équipe nationale.

Sources indicate that la situation sportive de l'attaquant s'était toutefois compliquée lors des dernières semaines avec les Diables Rouges. Depuis la prise de fonction de Mark van Bommel comme sélectionneur en août 2026 en remplacement de Rudi Garcia, Romelu Lukaku a vu son temps de jeu diminuer au profit de Charles De Ketelaere. Resté sur le banc lors du récent succès face à l'Italie, le joueur a finalement choisi de renoncer aux prochaines échéances internationales de son pays. En effet, la Belgique disputera les quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations du 25 au 30 mars 2027, dont le tirage au sort est fixé au vendredi 20 novembre 2026 à Nyon.

Toutefois, cette retraite internationale ne met absolument pas un terme à sa carrière en club. Romelu Lukaku évolue sous les couleurs de Fenerbahçe depuis le mois d'août 2026 et reste concentré sur ses objectifs en Turquie. L'attaquant disputera ainsi son prochain match officiel le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 17h00 face à Kocaelispor en Süper Lig.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Andoni Iraola wanted to talk about his team and their need to improve but how could he concentrate on something so straightforward when he had seen something so bizarre?

It is vital, first and foremost, to explain this is not painting a narrative about Liverpool being unfortunate. Far from it. Iraola hissed his dismay that Nottingham Forest had shown more intensity and been the better team for long periods in an entertaining 2-2 draw.

But the penalty that changed the contest? Iraola, his coaching staff, even the supporters behind the dugout had been left flabbergasted that the malfunctioning number board of fourth official Tim Robinson presented an avenue for Forest to exploit.

Iraola had tried to make a triple change, wanting to introduce Ryan Gravenberch, Kostas Tsimikas and Rio Ngumoha, but as Robinson pressed buttons to no avail and everyone in Red became frustrated, Forest substitute Liam Delap took a quick throw and the Liverpool house almost caved in.

Neco Williams, once of Liverpool, surged into the penalty area, Alisson Becker arrived a fraction too late after the defender got his shot away and took his old team-mate down. Morgan Gibbs-White exacerbated the damage when sending Alisson the wrong way and this was the last thing a manager wanting to make an impression on a substantial day needed to see but this was reality.

Industry observers note that alisson takes out Neco Williams and Forest have a penalty! 😱📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/fX2flY3Tob.

Gibbs-White converts from the spot to restore Forest's lead! 🌳🎯📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/jeoPiXPArw.

According to recent reports, “I cannot explain because I don’t have an explanation,” Iraola said. “I wanted to make those substitutions about three minutes before. I mean, it was two, three, four times the ball had gone out. I still don’t know the reason why we couldn’t make the subs.

According to recent reports, “I think [the fourth official] was having some problems with the board or something. It [the penalty] wouldn’t have happened if I had made the sub. I asked. I had complained the previous time. The supporters were shouting and they were aware of the situation. But I don’t know what happened and I don’t know why they have given the penalty.”.

“A lack of intensity hurt us,” Iraola remarked with obvious disdain and it was only down to a show of character in the second period that a slovenly first half did not enable Forest to win at Anfield for the third consecutive year, for all that the travelling fans thought it was “happening again!”.

Recent findings suggest that forest, bruised after two defeats in four days to Leeds, looked like an Oliver Glasner side. They were aggressive and well organised, the only failing was that physically they could not see the job through, but the Austrian insisted that will change in due course.

Once Glasner is settled in and he gets his transfer business done – “definitely one, possibly two and probably three,” was his mischievous reply to how the window will unfold – Forest will be a formidable proposition, especially if the first 45 minutes are a barometer.

They had been knocking on the door before Dan Ndoye eventually broke the deadlock, sweeping a left-footed drive past Alisson after Igor Jesus had won a header from a long clearance. It was a simple goal, marginally onside, but it was absolutely deserved.

It’s a bizarre situation for Liverpool. They could easily be level or be 2-0 down. But they trial just 1-0 at half-time. Wirtz and Gakpo are looking lively, but Isak has struggled to influence the game.

Dan Ndoye scores his first goal in the Premier League in 377 days 🤯 pic.twitter.com/tjSiGoSPyW.

Forest have a slender one-goal advantage at the break after a frantic first half at Anfield. Ndoye curled the visitors into a well-deserved lead after 24 minutes, before Wirtz had a goal ruled out for offside. The German was then sensationally denied by Sels’ diving save as he tipped Wirtz’s header over the bar. Alisson then replicated Sels’ heroics, parrying Igor Jesus’ strike against the woodwork to stop Forest from doubling their lead.

What a move and what a save! Murillo sprays an inch-perfect pass out to Aina, who chops inside of Munoz and fires a low cross into Igor Jesus. The Forest striker shoots first-time from inside the penalty area, but his effort is sensationally parried onto the bar by Alisson. That is a world-class stop from the Brazilian goalkeeper.

Industry observers note that A world-class save from Alisson denies Forest a second! 🤯🧤📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/4NtzROILrU.

Igor Jesus receives the game’s first yellow card after clipping Mac Allister with an unnecessary challenge.

In a recent development, liverpool then fly forward again as Gakpo nutmegs Williams. His cross trickles through to Munoz at the back post. The ball is slightly behind Munoz and he leans back before shooting, causing his strike to narrowly sail over the bar.

There will be three minutes of added time to conclude this first half.

In a recent development, liverpool are applying all the pressure at the end of this first half. At times, Forest have had every outfield player behind the ball.

Sels makes a superb save! Gakpo takes on his marker on the outside and fires in a cross which Wirtz meets. The attacker gets in between Schlager and Aina to win the header, but his effort is excellently tipped over the bar by Sels.

Out of nothing, Liverpool are level. McAtee attempts to play out from a deep position and his pass is intercepted by Wirtz. The ball breaks to Frimpong, who slips a clever pass to Wirtz. The German playmaker swivels and slides a low effort into the bottom corner. It’s a brilliant finish, but Frimpong was in an offside position before he provided the assist. VAR confirms this and Liverpool’s joy has been cut short. That is a huge let off for Forest, who need to be more careful with possession in deeper areas.

Recent findings suggest that following that Forest goal, there was a small flurry of Liverpool pressure, with Szoboszlai having a free kick punched away by Sels. Murillo is then very careless with the ball and is dispossessed. This allowed Mac Allister to play in Isak, but the striker is crowded out by multiple Forest defenders before he can get a shot away.

In a recent development, for the third season in a row, Nottingham Forest lead at Anfield. The goal had been coming, too. Liverpool were bright early but suddenly big gaps have started appearing and Forest are wily enough to exploit. There are lots of gripes around the stands about it being “too easy” and this knowledgeable crowd are right. A long ball forward and a simple flick has caused mayhem.

Forest are ahead and are well worth their lead. Sels launches a long ball up to Igor Jesus, who takes it down with an exquisite touch. The ball then breaks to Gibbs-White. The Forest captain plays in Ndoye and the winger curls a clinical effort into the far bottom corner to send the away support wild.

According to recent reports, ndoye gives Forest the lead at Anfield! 🌳🔥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/ag0oZ7UjTm.

Liverpool are struggling to find any space in and around Forest’s midfield and defence. Isak and Wirtz have been on the periphery as the time ticks over midway point of the first half.

Huge chance for Forest! McAtee drops deep and picks out Ndoye with a teasing cross. The forward meets the delivery and his header bounces wide. Upon the replays, there looks to have been a push on Frimpong by Ndoye. The referee’s whistle wasn’t sounded so it would have been interesting to see what would of happened if that chance had been converted.

It’s been a really frantic start to this game. Out of possession, Forest are retreating into a really rigid back five formation. Going forward, Aina and Williams are getting up the pitch at every opportunity.

It has been revealed that aina stands up an inviting cross to the back post for Ndoye, who heads it back into the danger zone. Igor Jesus latches onto it, but Jacquet makes a goal-saving tackle to block the striker’s close-range effort.

According to recent reports, sensational block from Jeremy Jacquet to deny Igor Jesus! 🤯📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/XuhO1GuE9F.

Van Dijk clips a long ball over to the onrushing Isak as Liverpool look to burst forward on the counter. Isak races onto it and enters the penalty area, but he’s chased by Jair Cunha who matches the striker for pace. There’s a shoulder-to-shoulder, and the Forest defender bumps Isak off the ball, before Milenkovic comes back to mop up the danger.

Ndoye attempts to sprint in behind Liverpool’s defence. He’s chased by Jacquet and Ndoye can’t quite take the ball under his spell. That is an early warning sign for Liverpool.

The hosts then go up the other end as Mac Allister threads a delightful pass through to Gakpo. The Liverpool forward tries to swivel and shoot, but Williams tracks back and makes a crucial tackle.

Sources indicate that frimpong gets in behind Forest’s backline and attempts to pick out Gakpo with a cross aimed towards the back post. However, the ball bobbles and the Liverpool right back overhits his delivery.

Industry observers note that A very intriguing team selected by Andoni Iraola and one that illustrates his confidence. It could be viewed as big call to drop Ryan Gravenberch and Rio Ngumoha but Victor Munoz and Alexis Mac Allister both made a difference when they were introduced at St James’s Park last Sunday and they warrant their inclusion. Munoz won’t be fit enough to play 90 minutes but it will be fascinating to watch him, particularly as Bradley Barcola will soon arrive to play in the same position on the left flank.

It has been revealed that we are now under way at Anfield. Can Iraola mark his first competitive home game with a win or will Glasner get up and running with Forest?

In a recent development, A roaring rendition of You’ll Never Walk Alone has just boomed around Anfield. We will now observe a minute’s applause for Liverpool legend Kevin Keegan, who passed away at the age of 75 in July.

According to recent reports, A very poignant and colourful tribute to Kevin Keegan, with Anfield paying its respects to one of its favourite sons. The atmosphere is good and the onus is on the team to maintain it. This won’t be easy, as Nottingham Forest arrive here with a point to prove under Oliver Glasner. The big story with Forest will come later, with their pursuit of Everton’s Harrison Armstrong. It it is a transfer that is causing huge discussion on Merseyside.

Both sets of players are out onto the pitch and are met by an electric atmosphere at Anfield.

Industry observers note that on the development, Bhatia told Liverpool’s website: “It feels incredible. It feels surreal when I hear those words, obviously an incredibly proud moment for myself, for my family, for our partners. We’re talking about Liverpool Football Club here, right? I mean, we’re talking about the greatest football club in the world. And so to have the ability to be involved in any capacity is a huge privilege and a huge honour.”.

Having been linked to both Tottenham Hotspur and Manchester City, Cody Gakpo’s Liverpool future has looked doubtful at points this summer.

However, Spurs’ signings of Savinho and Omar Marmoush, as well as Manchester City’s potentially big-money pursuit of Enzo Fernandez, means that any exit for the Dutchman looks extremely complicated.

Nottingham Forest have smashed their club-record transfer fee to sign Chelsea striker Liam Delap for £50m on a five-year deal, ending a lengthy pursuit by both the club and their head coach Oliver Glasner.

Last summer Delap held talks with Forest and Glasner, while he was in charge at Crystal Palace, before he opted to join his mentor and former Manchester City Under-21 coach Enzo Maresca at Stamford Bridge.

Good morning and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League match between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest at Anfield.

This encounter pits two summer appointments – Andoni Iraola and Oliver Glasner – against each other as they both search for their first top-flight win at their upcoming clubs.

In a recent development, in the opening Premier League game-week, Iraola’s Liverpool needed a last-gasp 99th-minute penalty from Dominik Szoboszlai to rescue an unconvincing 2-2 draw with Newcastle United at St. James’ Park. Meanwhile, Nottingham Forest have suffered back-to-back home defeats in four days against Leeds United without scoring (1-0 Premier League, 2-0 Carabao Cup).

Iraola has been handed the unenviable task of steering Liverpool back on track following a hugely disappointing campaign under Arne Slot, whose side’s defence of their Premier League ended in a meek fifth-place finish despite spending more than £400m in the previous summer.

The former Bournemouth boss must uncover how to get the best out of big-money recruits such as Alexander Isak, Florian Wirtz, Milos Kerkez and Jeremie Frimpong, and also tighten up Liverpool’s vulnerable midfield and defence. Given the pressure of the job and the club’s hectic schedule while balancing domestic and European football, it’s a tough ask. However, Liverpool have agreed a £120m deal for Paris St-Germain winger Bradley Barcola to bolster their attacking reinforcements, but the transfer hasn’t been finalised in time for today’s match.

In a recent development, last season, Forest endured an equally tumultuous campaign, churning through a staggering four managers, before eventually stumbling to a 16th-place finish. Glasner has been hand-picked by owner Evangelos Marinakis to usher in an era of stability and success, after winning the FA Cup, Community Shield and Conference League in just over two years at Crystal Palace.

Both Marinakis and Glasner are extremely ambitious and demanding figures. You’d imagine a top-half finish would be considered the absolute minimum for Forest, while Glasner’s track record of winning trophies surely indicates that Marinakis is eyeing some silverware at the City Ground.

According to recent reports, it’s a meeting of two managers who must deliver. Three points for either side would serve as a much-needed tonic to kickstart their seasons.

Kick-off is at 12:30, with team news coming shortly.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Présent en conférence de presse ce lundi 16 novembre 2026 à Singapour, Vinicius Jr a livré une mise au point sans détour sur ses récentes difficultés avec le Real Madrid. L'attaquant brésilien a admis avoir diminué son volume d'entraînement estival, profondément affecté par l'élimination précoce de sa sélection lors de la dernière Coupe du monde.

In a recent development, ce début d'exercice s'avère particulièrement difficile pour le joueur de 26 ans sous les couleurs du club espagnol. Avec un bilan de seulement un but et trois passes décisives en 12 rencontres toutes compétitions confondues avec le Real Madrid, Vinicius Jr traverse une période délicate. Un rendement bien loin de ses standards. La cause de ce passage à vide trouve son origine dans les suites de la Coupe du monde, où le Brésil a quitté la compétition dès les huitièmes de finale après une défaite face à la Norvège (2-1). Très affecté par ce revers, l'attaquant a ainsi privilégié le repos et la déconnexion en famille durant ses vacances, au détriment de sa préparation physique.

Devant les médias à Singapour, l'ailier madrilène a d'ailleurs détaillé avec franchise les raisons de ce déficit athlétique :.

Sources indicate that au-delà de cette déception internationale, le contexte extra-sportif n'a pas aidé le joueur du Real Madrid à aborder cette saison l'esprit totalement libéré. En effet, le dossier de sa prolongation contractuelle et les sollicitations extérieures, notamment l'intérêt de clubs comme Arsenal, ont perturbé sa concentration estivale. L'attaquant a ainsi reconnu que ces remous avaient directement influé sur son niveau de jeu depuis la reprise.

It has been revealed that toutefois, l'ailier madrilène a tenu à rappeler la difficulté de se maintenir au sommet dans la durée. Pour appuyer son constat, il a souligné que seuls Cristiano Ronaldo et Lionel Messi ont su afficher de telles statistiques pendant de longues années. Le numéro 7 brésilien a également rappelé son devoir d'exemplarité, affirmant être conscient que s'il court davantage, tous les jeunes joueurs courront aussi plus.

Vinicius Jr a tempéré les inquiétudes en comparant sa trajectoire à celle de la saison passée, où il ne comptait que 5 buts en décembre avant de dépasser la barre des 20 réalisations au printemps. L'attaquant reste ainsi convaincu que sa montée en puissance physique portera ses fruits au moment opportun.

Sur le plan sportif en sélection, Vinicius Jr s'est d'ailleurs redonné de la confiance en signant un doublé samedi 14 novembre 2026 lors de la défaite du Brésil contre le Japon (2-3) au Stade national de Singapour. Le Brésil dispute désormais son prochain match amical face à Singapour le mardi 17 novembre 2026 à 11h00 (heure française) au Stade national de Singapour. Le prochain rendez-vous de Vinicius Jr avec le Real Madrid est ensuite programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 21h00 face au Celta Vigo au stade Santiago-Bernabéu pour la 13e journée de Liga.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il centrocampista classe 2011 è stato impiegato da Rughetti in tutte le partite della stagione.

In a recent development, andrea Morresi è il regista del centrocampo della Lazio di Rughetti. Secondo quanto riportato da Gazzetta Regionale, Il classe 2011, arrivato dal Perugia nell’estate del 2025, gioca davanti alla difesa ed è stato impiegato dal tecnico in tutte le partite di questa stagione. Nel derby con la Roma, un suo filtrante ha messo Coppola nelle condizioni di segnare il gol del momentaneo 2-1.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Morresi era approdato nella capitale nella passata stagione, entrando nell’Under 15. Si è preso presto le chiavi della mediana biancoceleste, interpretando il ruolo di playmaker anche nel campionato attuale. La sua presenza è un punto fermo nelle scelte di Rughetti.

Prima del passaggio al Perugia, Morresi è cresciuto nel settore giovanile della Treiese, dai Piccoli Amici ai Pulcini. L’arrivo alla Lazio nell’estate del 2025 ha aperto una nuova tappa del suo percorso: con la maglia biancoceleste ha trovato spazio stabilmente davanti alla difesa.

In quella posizione gestisce il pallone, distribuisce il gioco e cerca gli spazi per i compagni. Alla visione di gioco unisce tecnica e corsa nelle due fasi. Il suo destro si è già fatto notare anche sui calci di punizione, una soluzione con cui può rendersi decisivo.

Sources indicate that il suo contributo non si esaurisce però nella regia arretrata. Quando si apre la possibilità, Morresi avanza verso la trequarti avversaria. È dunque coinvolto sia nella costruzione delle azioni sia nel lavoro che precede le iniziative offensive della squadra.

Industry observers note that fino alla domenica del derby, la Lazio condivideva con la Roma l’imbattibilità in campionato. I biancocelesti si presentavano alla sfida con una struttura difensiva che li rendeva la seconda miglior difesa del raggruppamento. Anche il lavoro di Morresi davanti alla retroguardia contribuisce all’equilibrio della squadra.

Contro i giallorossi, il numero 4 ha giocato in una zona di campo particolarmente affollata. Dall’altra parte c’era il miglior attacco del girone, capace di mettere alla prova la mediana biancoceleste. La Roma ha prevalso per 3-1 dopo aver dominato gran parte degli 80 minuti, ma nella ripresa la Lazio ha trovato la forza di reagire.

L’episodio che ha riaperto momentaneamente la partita è nato dai piedi di Morresi. Un suo passaggio filtrante ha raggiunto Coppola in posizione favorevole; il compagno ha poi mandato il pallone in rete per il 2-1. La speranza biancoceleste si è spenta con il terzo gol romanista, firmato da Abate.

Hamilton Academical 1 Ross County 2.

The depth of the descent of Hamilton Accies and Ross County would make it understandable if tickets for a fixture between the two carried warning about the bends when leaving Upcoming Douglas Park.

Sources indicate that the decompression sickness caused by emerging from a League One fixture for two sides who should be much higher must be severe. There may, however, be a positive prognosis.

Accies, despite their defeat, are whispering about stability, even though ‘legacy debt’ has to be faced, perhaps contested.

It has been revealed that county, meanwhile, will not say it even in a whisper but Saturday’s victory takes them eight points clear at the top and heavily fancied for the title. The Staggies have one set of hooves in the Championship.

According to recent reports, scottish football, of course, does not restrict itself to the cliched fare of top of the table clashes so Upcoming Douglas Park hosted a striker who is 39 later this month, a winger who was once a Scottish international, and a gentleman in the stands who once played against George Best. And a Ross County fan who regularly travels up from North Wales.

These exotic avenues demand to be explored but perennial questions about the financial health of the Accies had to be asked, too, after reports this week stating that hospitality packages at the club were being suspended.

An Accies fan feels the pain of defeat during Saturday's home loss to Ross County.

Allan Currie, chairman, answered them over a half-time pie.

Industry observers note that ‘We have come on in leaps and bounds but every week seems to throw up different challenges,’ he noted. ‘We have a level of debt that we have inherited and we are working with the creditors to try to navigate our way through that.’.

Matters on the field are positive, despite Saturday’s defeat.

‘The guys on the pitch, manager, and his staff have been unbelievable. Surviving in this league last season was phenomenal given what they were going through but it couldn’t be better now,’ he noted. ‘Off the pitch, we are fighting with the different challenges we have. We are in a much better place even if we are not out the woods yet.’.

Asked what the level of pressure on him, he noted: ‘I am the guy on the ground but Rob Edwards is carrying out negotiations.’.

Recent findings suggest that edwards, through his Morley Group, took over the club earlier this year but has been sideswiped by a number of claims for payment. However, Currie has faith in the owner.

In a recent development, ‘Without him, the club would not survive. Rob should take all the credit,’ he said.

Asked what the short-term aims for the club were, Currie replied with a smile: ‘A goal in the second half would be good.’ A goal was scored but not for the Accies.

But the club remain in second place and the play-offs seem a more than reasonable prospect.

Ross County goalscorer Kieran Phillips battles with Hamilton's Kai Smutek.

In a recent development, with 10 minutes to go, Hamilton brought on their latest signing. Barrie McKay, who has played for Scotland and scored for Rangers in a Scottish Cup semi-final against Celtic. His considerable achievements, though, paled in comparison to the subject of a casual conversation in the bar before the match.

‘I played against George Best,’ mentioned Alan McDougall, with an air so off-hand one could have believed he was merely ordering another pint.

‘Yes, I played 200 games for the Accies. Davie McParland brought me here as a 21-year-old and I played for about six years. I went to Stranraer for a year and then went down south. I played against Best with the Accies.’.

The Northern Irish genius played for Hibernian in 1979-80. ‘He was well past his best and that was sad,’ said McDougall. Best’s addiction to alcohol had taken a severe toll.

‘I came back to watch games five or six years ago,’ said McDougall. ‘When the club went to Clyde, it destroyed me. What is fantastic is that the people that are now in control seem to be turning it around.’.

There was a mood of cautious optimism from other fans. ‘I have been a fan since forever, well the 1980s at least,’ said Gavin Fullarton. ‘I have seen this team in every division. I have seen them in the downs and downs. But I think we are going in the right direction. So far.’.

He added: ‘The fresh guys seem to know what they are doing. They are communicative.’.

According to recent reports, there were 1,216 fans in the ground on Saturday with 300 stalwarts travelling down from the north. Colin Richardson, an Accies supporter, was asked why so many had stuck by the club.

It has been revealed that ‘It’s about loyalty,’ he said. ‘You can’t pick and choose when you support your team. At the moment it is all about small steps. It has to be about stability.’.

A Ross County fan had travelled up from North Wales. The journey to Scotland is a familiar one for Ian Ellson. ‘I have been all over Scotland to watch Ross County,’ he stated. ‘Twenty years ago I visited Ross County and I was spoiled rotten. I decided to follow them.’.

Sources indicate that A social worker, he averages one visit a month. ‘I live and breathe Ross County,’ he remarked. ‘This season we are going up.’.

Welsh Staggies fan Ian Elson and Englishman Ray Griffiths travelled far for Saturday's game.

In a recent development, brian Graham would not be so bullish. He is 39 this month and has learned enough about football to know that predictions are made only to make the speaker seem foolish down the line.

He was, though, expansive about what is happening at County. He joined the club for the second time in the summer after Stuart Kettlewell, the manager, convinced him of the ambitions in Dingwall.

‘This is a club where I have had success before so I know how good a club it can be,’ he noted. ‘It’s not been great for a couple of seasons but in the summer the manager set out his stall very early. It was about leaving egos at the door, building a togetherness and having a change of culture at the club. I think you are seeing that now.’.

The early signs were good for the striker who dropped down from Falkirk in the Premiership to play in Dingwall.

‘We had good pre-season performances against Aberdeen and Dundee and that was a solid building block,’ he said.

Brian Graham celebrates after scoring his 21st goal of the season for County.

According to recent reports, graham converted a first-half penalty to reach a tally of 21 goals this season and the Christmas trees are not up yet. ‘I get a lot of plaudits for scoring goals but others in the team are scoring a lot too,’ he said. ‘We are scoring team goals.’.

Sources indicate that has he set a target for the season? ‘When I came back I knew I had to score 13 to reach 50 goals for the club in two spells,’ he noted. ‘I always set down targets in a wee black book but now I might need to readjust that.’.

Industry observers note that it was a night of adjustment for Darian MacKinnon. He had set a victory target but was condemned to accept defeat. He would not concede the league race was over. ‘We have to play them twice,’ he said.

Recent findings suggest that he added ‘We are going in the right direction. The owners have put money in and they have backed us.’.

Sources indicate that asked to pinpoint a factor that has contributed to the team sitting second, he said: ‘The most positive thing for me this season is that this is now a good place to come into your work after the last three or four seasons. We are all actually enjoying coming to our work.’.

In a recent development, there is work to be done on and off the pitch but the Accies are surviving. And that is the biggest result.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Published: 10:42 EST, 14 November 2026 | Updated: 11:33 EST, 15 November 2026.
  • Chelsea secured a deserved 1-0 victory over Manchester City at Stamford Bridge to leapfrog their rivals and reclaim top spot in the WSL table.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By SAMARA WATTS and TARA ANSON-WALSH, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 10:42 EST, 14 November 2026 | Updated: 11:33 EST, 15 November 2026.

Chelsea secured a deserved 1-0 victory over Manchester City at Stamford Bridge to leapfrog their rivals and reclaim top spot in the WSL table.

Sandy Baltimore's first-half goal was enough to ensure Chelsea inflicted City's first defeat of the season and blow the title race wide open.

After keeping the reigning WSL champions at bay following an early barrage, Chelsea grew in confidence but still lacked the cutting edge that had seen them held to back-to-back draws in the past week.

A moment of magic from Baltimore in the fourth minute of stoppage time ensured history would not repeat itself.

City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita was sent off in the 75th minute for a rash challenge on Alyssa Thompson, a move which appeared to invigorate the visitors, but Chelsea held firm to pick up all three points.

Daily Mail Sport's Tara Anson-Walsh and Samara Watts were at Stamford Bridge to bring you the things we learned...

Chelsea inflicted City's first defeat of the season and blew the title race wide open.

City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita was sent off in the 75th minute for a rash challenge on Alyssa Thompson.

Devastation for Kadeisha Buchanan, who was hooked after 11 minutes by Bompastor. The centre back has been one of Chelsea’s standout performers this season but had an unusually shaky start to this match as she looked out of her depth against Bunny Shaw, ever a precarious place to be against the league’s top striker.

Buchanan gave an early ball away to allow Shaw to race through towards the Chelsea goal, and a few minutes later was again outmuscled and outpaced by the Jamaican striker, although City failed to capitalise on both occasions.

The 31-year-old Canada international looked devastated when her number flashed up on the board after just 12 minutes and reluctantly welcomed a hug from her manager as she headed straight for the tunnel.

Her replacement, the 20-year-old Veerle Buurman, who was outstanding against Shaw in the two sides’ last meeting in the FA Cup last season, changed the game, giving Chelsea a more solid platform to build upon as they grew in confidence.

Bompastor shut down suggestions that the move had been ruthlessly tactical at full time, saying that Buchanan had picked up a head injury during training on Friday.

'She was fine after the training session, she was fine in the evening and we assessed her again this morning and everything was fine,' Bompastor said.

Recent findings suggest that 'I had this information on what happened yesterday and I just felt, watching her from the beginning of the game, she was not herself. I took the responsibility to make this substitution. I was almost forced to do that because, I know my player, and I know she was not right in the game.'.

For those sceptical, it certainly improved things.

The centre back has been one of Chelsea’s standout performers this season but had an unusually shaky start to this match and was hooked after just 11 minutes.

Women’s football royalty Sarina Wiegman and Emma Hayes braved the chilly climes of Stamford Bridge to witness the showdown between the WSL heavyweights on Saturday afternoon.

The freshly anointed honorary Dame Wiegman sat next to Hayes and the pair chatted warmly, with Wiegman laughing as Hayes attempted to encourage her to celebrate Chelsea's victory at full time. This is a relationship that will no doubt drop in cordiality as the sand in the hourglass ahead of next summer’s World Cup continues to run down.

It has been revealed that wiegman had several England players on her watching brief, not least young Lexi Potter, whose stock has risen dramatically this season. The 20-year-old put in another assured performance against the reigning champions, continuing to demonstrate her maturity in the highest stakes, which will no doubt put her in a good position ahead of Tuesday’s squad announcement.

Elsewhere, the Dutch coach will have been alarmed by the number of crunching tackles put in against her right back, Lucy Bronze, in this match. If there is one player that she will want to wrap up in cotton wool ahead of Brazil, it is the recently turned 35-year-old Bronze for her steadfast leadership and relentless athleticism.

One player looking to make an impact ahead of Tuesday’s squad announcement was Aggie Beever-Jones, who has struggled this season and was left out of Sonia Bompastor’s starting line-up. An injury to Melvine Malard saw Beever-Jones gain more minutes than she would have expected, but it felt like another afternoon of deja vu for the 23-year-old forward as she failed to convert a number of chances despite finding herself in good positions.

Meanwhile, in Manchester, Ella Toone's hopes of forcing her way back into Sarina Wiegman's intends suffered another blow as the 27-year-old was once again left out of Eva Olid's starting line-up for United's 2-0 win over Crystal Palace. Toone watched on as fellow Lioness Maya Le Tissier opened the scoring with a superb long-range strike, and the two-time European champion will no doubt be growing increasingly concerned as Brazil draws closer.

The freshly anointed honorary dame Wiegman sat next to Hayes at the WSL showpiece at Stamford Bridge and the pair chatted warmly.

Melvine Malard’s absence raises questions about who Chelsea’s main goalscorer will be this season. The squad has lacked a clinical edge without England striker Lauren James, who is out with a hamstring injury until the international break.

The French forward went off injured after 35 minutes with a suspected hamstring injury. Although she missed Chelsea’s opening games after picking up a knock in pre-season, she has been the Blues’ top scorer in the absence of Lauren James with six league goals so far.

According to recent reports, chelsea are averaging 24 shots per game, an unprecedented rate across a WSL campaign, but have recently struggled to convert their chances. They were held to a 0-0 draw against BK Hacken midweek in the UWCL and a 1-1 draw against Everton last weekend.

It has been revealed that malard leaving the pitch meant Chelsea struggled to find a creative spark up front. Her replacement Aggie Beever-Jones has been dealing with an ankle injury, and is still trying to find her feet with only one goal in the WSL.

Head coach Bompastor noted: ‘The frustration sometimes comes from us not being ruthless and clinical.’.

It has been revealed that A moment of magic from Malard’s French international teammate Sandy Baltimore was enough to make it 1-0 just before half time with the team’s first shot on target. However, Baltimore was substituted at half time to manage her minutes, and Chelsea were unable to capitalize on any of their chances in the second half.

Bompastor said: ‘From the outside it seems like we have had a lot of injuries, but we have been playing every three days.’.

‘I knew coming into the game we were not as fresh as we would like to be, but that’s our environment.

‘We want to play in every competition but the players are not robots,’.

Melvine Malard’s injury could cause more problems for the Blues’ attack, as they registered just two shots on target today and scraped the three points.

Malard limped off in the first half and meant Chelsea struggled for a creative spark up front.

Stamford Bridge was in uproar as City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita rushed out of her box and took down Alyssa Thompson, who had a clear chance on goal in the 75th minute.

The Blues were mounting a rapid attack down the left hand side, with Thompson just outside the box when Yamashita missed the ball and brought her to the ground.

Industry observers note that the Japanese goalkeeper was shown a straight red card and was sent off the pitch. This was City’s first red card in the WSL since November 2023, and a rare moment of madness from the usually-composed 31-year-old.

The referee allowed City three minutes to replace the Japanese goalkeeper, with Scotland’s number one Eartha Cumings coming on to replace forward Aoba Fujino.

Her first test arrived only a minute later, as Aggie Beever-Jones' right-footed shot from the resulting indirect free kick dropped dangerously, but she was saved by the crossbar.

The bigger question now is whether Yamashita's absence - which could amass to three games - will have a lasting impact on their title race.

Recent findings suggest that in the short-term against Chelsea, City reacted well. Andree Jeglertz stated at full time: ‘The players dealt with it in a good way, so even though we were one player down we had a couple of great opportunities to score a goal. Of course it affected the game but that is not why we lost.’.

Stamford Bridge was in uproar as Manchester City goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita rushed out of her box to take down Alyssa Thompson, who had a clear chance on goal.

Chelsea’s win at the Bridge blows the title race wide open, as they are now just one point ahead of City at the top of the WSL table.

Bompastor’s side ended City’s unbeaten streak, and they now have 24 league goals compared to City’s 16 after 10 games.

However, with seven shots and just one on target this game, Chelsea will need to look at their attacking options as they take on Liverpool and London City Lionesses before the international break.

Bompastor stated: ‘It’s a nice feeling to be top of the table right now and to win against these top sides, but I know we still have a lot of work to be done and it’s early on in the season so many things can happen.’.

City were unable to create opportunities in front of goal, with the WSL’s all-time leading goalscorer Vivianne Miedema’s return overshadowed by Ayaka Yamashita’s nightmare in goal.

City head coach Andree Jeglertz stated: ‘They managed to score on their big chance and (it was a) great finish.

'We also had some great opportunities where we didn’t manage to score, but I think we deserve more than going away from here with no points.’.

London City Lionesses face Arsenal tomorrow at the Emirates, and a win in north London could bring them four points behind the new WSL leaders, and really start to make things interesting.

£380m = zero points: Massive-spending Spurs humbled by Newcastle

📅 29 Aug 2026 | ⏱️ 24 min read (4814 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~24 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • These remain the earliest of early days but the blunt facts are there for all to see.
  • Not since 1974 has a Spurs team lost the first two games of a league campaign without finding the net.
  • Recent findings suggest that this meeting with Newcastle United was, in the minds of those Spurs fans, meant to be a clash between a team remade by the transfer market and a team broken by it.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

These remain the earliest of early days but the blunt facts are there for all to see. Tottenham Hotspur, the club that has spent around £380m this summer in search of instant improvements, have played twice and lost twice in the Premier League. After making eight newly introduced signings, they have so far scored zero goals and won zero points.

Not since 1974 has a Spurs team lost the first two games of a league campaign without finding the net. The summer enthusiasm in this corner of north London is therefore already drifting away, to the sound of an alarmingly familiar soundtrack: boos from the home supporters at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.

Recent findings suggest that this meeting with Newcastle United was, in the minds of those Spurs fans, meant to be a clash between a team remade by the transfer market and a team broken by it. Yet it was Newcastle, still adjusting to the loss of three key players this summer, who looked the more unified group and more organised team.

Sources indicate that it proved to be a truly glorious evening for the visiting supporters, who not only delighted in their team’s victory but also in the struggles of Sandro Tonali. The £100m Italian, who swapped Newcastle for Spurs a few weeks ago, never came close to offering the sort of class one would expect for such a fee. That price tag is not his fault but it is his burden, and in time he will need to shoulder it more impressively than he did here.

Roberto De Zerbi, the Spurs head coach, can rightly say that it will take time for his fresh group to develop the cohesion he needs. The worrying reality for Spurs, though, is that his opposite number had far less time to work with his players and far less money to reshape his squad. Matthias Jaissle appears to be a man with a defined plan, and an ability to convey it. Newcastle improved considerably after half-time, which spoke volumes of Jaissle’s work. “He is the best signing of Newcastle so far,” remarked Yoane Wissa of his new coach.

"He is the best signing for Newcastle"Yoane Wissa praises Matthias Jaissle's impact at the club since becoming head coach 👔 pic.twitter.com/dX8nVknpKc.

For Spurs, so much of it would have felt painfully similar to last season, when they won only three home games in the Premier League. They played some pretty football in bursts, but not at the crucial points of the game. The second half, especially, was pockmarked with moments of despair. There was Mathys Tel’s free-kick that almost flew into Islington, for example, and Mateus Fernandes falling over when running onto a pass in the penalty area.

De Zerbi said he was sorry for the fans and for the club, and suggested his team is not properly prepared for this campaign. “Maybe we are not ready yet,” he said. “For many, many reasons we are not ready yet.”.

"I have no panic, I know very well where I'm going" Roberto De Zerbi apologises to Spurs fans after the defeat to Newcastle 🔊 pic.twitter.com/83DntjG5ZH.

Newcastle’s two goals, much like Brentford’s three last weekend, exposed the enduring frailties in the Spurs defence. Anthony Elanga’s opener stemmed from a long pass over the top of the home side’s high line, while Wissa’s acrobatic effort came from a corner kick that Spurs could not handle. Neither strike, it would be safe to say, was the result of world-class attacking play.

Anthony Elanga finishes brilliantly and celebrates just as Thierry Henry did against Spurs 💥 pic.twitter.com/l6qndlMrKm.

It has been revealed that what a GOAL from Yoane Wissa?! 🫨 pic.twitter.com/mjuHpaa4YY.

“After the first goal we lost confidence,” stated De Zerbi. “The reaction was not good enough, not what I want to see on the pitch. The solution is not to put the head down, but to react.”.

In a recent development, to be clear, Spurs were not quite as bad as they had been against Brentford on the opening day. They did create chances here, taking 17 shots and forcing a few terrific saves from Lukas Hornicek, Newcastle’s impressive goalkeeper. But in the key moments they suffered from the same absence of clarity and execution as they did last season. Troublingly, this seemed to affect the new signings as much as it did the longer-serving players.

Of the five upcoming arrivals who featured for Spurs, Tonali was the least effective. The Italian had been vigorously booed by the away fans before kick-off and the travelling Geordies waited with palpable excitement for his first mistake. Much to their delight, it arrived after only three minutes: an underhit pass, in his own half, which directly led to Micky van de Ven picking up a yellow card. Tonali was outshone by new Newcastle midfielder Nico Gonzalez, who excelled only a few days after completing his move from Manchester City.

"He's got an opportunity to be the main man"Jamie Redknapp praises Nico Gonzalez's performance on his debut 👏 pic.twitter.com/1ga3tsxXHA.

Sources indicate that might it have been different for Spurs if £75m winger Savio had been available? The Brazilian was electrifying on his debut in midweek, when he scored against Charlton Athletic in the League Cup, yet was unavailable here due to a minor injury. It instead fell to another signing from City, Omar Marmoush, to lead the attack. He was busy and floaty but never truly hurt Newcastle.

There are more changes to come at Spurs before Tuesday’s deadline. De Zerbi revealed after the game that Richarlison, Kevin Danso and Pape Matar Sarr have all asked to leave the club.

At least the complications facing his players appear clear to De Zerbi. His list of areas to improve was lengthy – he spoke of strengthening the connection between the players, the quality of their play, their work in the defensive phase and the distances between them – but he also insisted he loves them and remains confident in the club’s project. At this rate, though, the fans might not share that confidence for much longer.

The Tottenham boss told BBC Sport: “Disappointed for the result because until the first goal we conceded I think we played better than Newcastle. We lost ball possession in the first half because we didn’t defend in the right way, the distance between the defenders and attackers was too substantial. We can improve in the defensive phases but today was an unfair result.

“At the beginning of the second half we had some chance to create the potential chances. We created many chances to score, we have to improve the last decision, because that will make a difference. At the end we are disappointed for the result and our fans. We are working to be a great team. When we become a team I think we can change the story of the last two seasons for Tottenham.

Hello and welcome to our live coverage of this Premier League meeting between Tottenham and Newcastle United in North London.

Following consecutive 17th-place finishes in the last two seasons, Spurs are looking to enjoy a fresh start under Roberto De Zerbi without nervously looking over their shoulder at the perilous possibility of relegation.

Recent findings suggest that nevertheless, Spurs’ season started disastrously last weekend as they fell to a miserable 3-0 defeat against Brentford at the Gtech Community Stadium. Since that result, Spurs have responded with an emphatic 5-1 thrashing of Charlton Athletic in the Carabao Cup, and also confirmed the signings of Savinho and Omar Marmoush from Manchester City. De Zerbi will be looking to continue this newfound momentum in the club’s first top-flight home match of the 2026-27 campaign.

Sources indicate that newcastle United have undergone a summer of significant change. Eddie Howe stepped down as head coach after nearly five years in charge, while Sandro Tonali, Bruno Guimaraes and Anthony Gordon all departed the club for lucrative transfer fees. Tonali welcomes his former employers to his latest surroundings after joining Tottenham for £100m.

Despite this upheaval, Newcastle demonstrated admirable heart in latest boss Matthias Jaissle’s first game in charge, earning a hard-fought 2-2 draw with Liverpool at St. James’ Park on the opening weekend. Emotional tributes poured in for club legend Kevin Keegan as Alexander Isak made his return to the club he acrimoniously forced an exit from last summer.

Recent findings suggest that newcastle looked to be heading for a victory after goals from Anthony Elanga and Joe Willock, until Lewis Hall, who had played excellently, apprehended Liverpool substitute Victor Munoz in added time to concede a penalty. Dominik Szoboszlai smashed a clinical spot-kick into the top corner to rescue a point for the visitors. Newcastle bounced back from these dropped points with a tense 3-2 triumph over West Brom in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday evening.

A first Premier League win of the season is the aim for both clubs by the end of this evening.

Kick-off is at 17:30, with team news on the way shortly.
